class.name: JRPGMapCellCache
class.brief_description: What each cell of a map means for movement, compiled from its tiles and regions.

method.name: can_step
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a character on [param cell] can step toward [param direction].

method.name: compile
method.description: Returns the cache of [param map] drawn with [param tileset]'s baked flags. A tileset without baked flags gives every painted cell an open passage and no flags.

method.name: get_neighbor
method.description: Returns the cell next to [param cell] toward [param direction], wrapped around on a looping axis, or [code](-1, -1)[/code] past an edge that does not loop.

method.name: get_no_entry
method.description: Returns the sides (north 1, east 2, south 4, west 8) [param cell] cannot be entered from.

method.name: get_no_exit
method.description: Returns the sides (north 1, east 2, south 4, west 8) [param cell] cannot be left toward.

method.name: get_pass_mode
method.description: Returns [constant JRPGTilesetData.PASS_OPEN] or [constant JRPGTilesetData.PASS_BLOCKED] for [param cell].

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns the region of [param cell] (0 to 255).

method.name: get_size
method.description: Returns the map's size in cells.

method.name: get_terrain_tag
method.description: Returns the terrain tag of [param cell] (0 to 15).

method.name: get_word
method.description: Returns the word of [param cell]. Outside the map, a blocked cell.

method.name: get_words
method.description: Returns every cell's word, row by row: the [method JRPGTilesetData.pack_flags] layout with the region in bits 24 to 31.

method.name: has_cell
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] is inside the map.

method.name: has_flag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] has [param flag]: one of [constant JRPGTilesetData.FLAG_OVERHEAD], [constant JRPGTilesetData.FLAG_LADDER], [constant JRPGTilesetData.FLAG_BUSH], [constant JRPGTilesetData.FLAG_COUNTER] or [constant JRPGTilesetData.FLAG_DAMAGE].

method.name: update_cells
method.description: Compiles the cells at positions [param cells] (as [method JRPGMapData.get_cell_index] gives them) again, after a paint. The map must keep its size.

constants.constant: The bit where the region starts in a cell's word.
